context: Riku and Aoi recap a thrilling soccer match.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (ゴール/スピード/プレイ/連続/群) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昨日の試合、ゴールが決まった瞬間最高だった!
lines.en: Yesterday's match — the moment the goal went in was the best!
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: スピードが、すごかったらしいね!
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、連続でパスをつないだんだ。
lines.en: Yeah, they linked passes in a row.
lines.style: animated teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: チームの、プレイが見事だったの?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 一人の選手が、群を抜いてたよ。
lines.en: One player stood out from the crowd.
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 連続ゴールも、あったの?
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 後半に、連続でゴールしたんだ!
lines.en: In the second half, they scored consecutively!
lines.style: thrilled teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そのスピードあるプレイ、見たかったなー!
lines.en: I wish I'd seen that fast play!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
